evidence: 2026-10-16: guest checkout reached from the product page; contact, name, street, city and postal code filled from vault tokens, then expiry, name on card, card number and CVV filled into the four card-fields iframes (proxy reported 4 of 4 filled, test card). Pay (#checkout-pay-button) was clicked once and stayed on the page with 'Select a state / province': the vault address is outside the US and the checkout ships to the US only, so no payment request was made and no decline was seen.
gotchas: Custom domain, not *.myshopify.com — the shopify platform recipe's own notes flag a detect regression on custom-domain stores; on this run detect worked fine (script[src*=cdn.shopify.com] etc. matched, cart and checkout reached normally).

Add to cart via the /cart/<variantId>:1 permalink, then /cart, then the visible checkout button (button[name="checkout"] / #cart-drawer-checkout-button — which one renders varies by entry path). A direct goto to /checkout can 302/abort depending on cart state; going through the cart page's own button is the reliable path.

2026-10-16: /cart redirects to the home page with the cart drawer open; the drawer shows only express buttons (Amazon Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, Shop Pay), #cart-drawer-checkout-button is attached but hidden and button[name="checkout"] is absent. A direct goto to /checkout with a non-empty cart opened the one-page checkout without a redirect.

Card surface is the split card-fields iframes (iframe[name*="card-fields-number"] / -expiry / -verification / -name); all four mounted and the name/expiry frames accepted pressSequentially. Number/CVV were not attempted with a real value in this run (see note).
2026-10-16: all four card frames filled from vault tokens in the order expiry, name, number, CVV (input[name=expiry], input[name=name], input[name=number], input[name=verification_value]).

2026-10-16: a 'Where are we shipping to?' geofence modal covers the store on first visit from outside the US and intercepts every click until a country button is picked; the United States button is [id$="__geofencing"] button:has(img[alt="United States"]). Other countries' buttons lead to separate regional storefronts.
2026-10-16: /products/mens-wool-runner-2 now lands on the Men's Shoes collection; socks ($14–$18) are the cheapest items, at /collections/socks.

2026-10-16: the checkout's Country/Region select (select[name="countryCode"]) offers United States only. State (select[name="zone"]) is required: Pay with no state stays on the page with select[name="zone"][aria-invalid="true"] and the message 'Select a state / province', before any payment request. An address outside the US cannot complete this checkout.

2026-10-16: each shipping field name (firstName, lastName, address1, address2, city, postalCode) matches two inputs, the second a hidden autofill twin; input[name=…][aria-required] (and input[name="address1"][role="combobox"]) select the visible one.

2026-10-16: sign-in at /account/login is Shopify customer accounts: an Email box and a Continue button, then an emailed one-time code. There is no password field, so a vault login's password token has no field to fill there. Guest checkout needs no account.
2026-10-16: the 'Mobile phone (optional)' box under 'Remember me' at checkout creates a Shop account when filled; it is not required for the order.
